summary: px8my ships a browser redirect payload to a hardcoded attacker domain
details: The package's main file is a browser script that, when loaded via npm or a CDN such as jsDelivr, injects a full-viewport iframe pointing at the hardcoded external URL https://mfmz.bczpcdt.cn/H.html?c=0gjr and overlays a Chinese-language fake 'loading' mask on the host page. Any site including this script has its visitors silently navigated to that attacker-controlled destination. A shell script shipped in the tarball automates the campaign: it rewrites the mfmz.* redirect host in px.js, bumps the version, runs `npm publish`, and purges the jsDelivr cache for /npm/px8my/px.js, indicating the destination is rotated as hosts are taken down. Package metadata (description, author, keywords) is empty and no legitimate purpose is documented for the redirect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
